items.title: How much phantom stock loss builds up without a transaction?
items.description: Using the exact bug from L3 (a failed order still decrements stock by 1 unit before failing), drag the number of failed orders that occur. The naive version loses one unit of stock per failure with zero orders to show for it; the transactional version — which rolls back on every failure — always stays at zero lost stock, regardless of how many orders fail.
